messages:
maya: Heads up — saw a small cluster of GPU stall alerts around 02:09 UTC on edge-rack-3 during the warm-pool backfill window. NIC tx drops + ctxswitch timeouts.
jon: which allocator config was backfilling? Was this the fractional-slice backfill we rolled last sprint?
maya: yes the fractional backfill path. affected tenants: @rafa-service (demo) and a random PLG sandbox.
lee: hmm, we lowered the soft-affinity threshold to 60% to reduce cold starts; could be increasing co-location with dedicated slices.
anika: can you paste the kernel/NIC errors? curious if mlx5 or general PCIe chatter.
maya: logs: ```
[02:09:07] mlx5_core: TX queue 4 overflow
[02:09:08] GPU stall: ctxsw timeout
[02:09:09] netconsole: eth0 tx dropped: 123
```
jon: that pattern looks like PCIe/NIC contention rather than pure GPU memory. If fractional slices are on the same host as dedicated slices, their bursty egress can starve DMA w/ noisy interrupts.
rafa: my demos started getting 500s this morning. Sorry folks, i ramped a test page.
lee: mitigation options: 1) make backfill add a per-rack penalty if any dedicated slice exists, 2) enable temporary host-level TX shaping for low-priority slices, 3) quarantine backfill on racks with irq/pci spikes for a short window.
anika: +1 for quarantine probe. Implementation idea: probe monitors pci irq rate & mlx5 tx errors — if above threshold, set rack.backfill_disable_until = now + 30m and emit metric.
jon: for the allocator tweak i'd prefer a soft penalty: cost += rack.dedicated_count * BACKFILL_PENALTY. start BACKFILL_PENALTY=1200 and canary in eu-west. avoids hard blocks.
maya: agree. also we should flip on tc shaping as a short-term quick fix: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 250mbit burst 64k latency 50ms` only for pods labeled low-priority=true.
rafa: happy to throttle my jobs tonight to reduce blast radius.
lee: cost tradeoff question — steering backfill away will increase cold starts elsewhere. ballpark: noisy incidents cost ~$1.8k/week in ops+SLA, warm-pool miss churn ~+$900/week if we avoid racks — still net positive but i'll ping finance.
anika: i'll draft a mini-runbook: 1) set BACKFILL_PENALTY=1200 in allocator (canary eu-west), 2) deploy irq/tx probe and quarantine logic, 3) enable tc shaping on affected hosts as emergency.
jon: i'll do the canary deploy at 01:30 UTC and watch warm-pool miss rate + p99 latency. tagging @maya for handoff on host shaping if needed.
maya: thanks. ops-bot — please open an incident for traceability.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-3312 created: "edge-rack-3 fractional backfill -> NIC/PCIe contention causing GPU stalls". Pager: eng-infra, oncall-maya.
jon: quick note: make BACKFILL_PENALTY configurable per-region. APAC racks may need higher penalty.
lee: noted. after canary we can add region multipliers.
maya: ok leaving the thread open. i'll post follow-ups after canary metrics.
